verses.uthmani: ٱقۡتَرَبَ لِلنَّاسِ حِسَابُهُمۡ وَهُمۡ فِي غَفۡلَةٖ مُّعۡرِضُونَ
verses.indopak: اِقْتَرَبَ لِلنَّاسِ حِسَابُهُمْ وَهُمْ فِىْ غَفْلَةٍ مُّعْرِضُوْنَ ۚ
verses.transliteration: ﻿iqtaraba lilnnasi hisabuhum wahum fee ghaflatin mu'ridoona
verses.saheeh: [The time of] their account has approached for the people, while they are in heedlessness turning away.
verses.khattab: ˹The time of˺ people’s judgment has drawn near, yet they are heedlessly turning away
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Nigh has drawn for mankind, the people of Mecca, the deniers of the Resurrection, their reckoning, [on] the Day of Resurrection, yet they are heedless, of it, disregardful, of the preparation [required] for it by way of [embracing] faith.
verses.romanUrdu: Qareeb aa gaya hai logon ke hisaab ka waqt, aur woh hain ke gaflat mein mooh moadey huey hain

verses.uthmani: مَا يَأۡتِيهِم مِّن ذِكۡرٖ مِّن رَّبِّهِم مُّحۡدَثٍ إِلَّا ٱسۡتَمَعُوهُ وَهُمۡ يَلۡعَبُونَ
verses.indopak: مَا يَأْتِيْهِمْ مِّنْ ذِكْرٍ مِّنْ رَّبِّہِمْ مُّحْدَثٍ اِلَّا اسْتَمَعُوْهُ وَهُمْ يَلْعَبُوْنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: ma yateehim min thikrin min rabbihim muhdathin illa istama'oohu wahum yal'aboona
verses.saheeh: No mention comes to them anew from their Lord except that they listen to it while they are at play
verses.khattab: Whatever new reminder comes to them from their Lord, they only listen to it jokingly
verses.jalalayn: ﻿There does not come to them any new reminder from their Lord, [revealed] gradually, in other words, [new] words of the Qur'an, but they listen to it as they play, [as they] engage in mockery,
verses.romanUrdu: Unke paas jo taaza naseehat bhi unke Rubb ki taraf se aati hai usko be-takalluf sunte hain aur khel mein padey rehte hain

verses.uthmani: لَاهِيَةٗ قُلُوبُهُمۡ ۗ وَأَسَرُّواْ ٱلنَّجۡوَى ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ هَلۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا بَشَرٞ مِّثۡلُكُمۡ ۖ أَفَتَأۡتُونَ ٱلسِّحۡرَ وَأَنتُمۡ تُبۡصِرُونَ
verses.indopak: لَاهِيَةً قُلُوْبُهُمْ ۗ وَاَسَرُّوا النَّجْوَى ۖ الَّذِيْنَ ظَلَمُوْا ۖ هَلْ هٰذَاۤ اِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ ۚ اَفَتَأْتُوْنَ السِّحْرَ وَاَنْتُمْ تُبْصِرُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: lahiyatan quloobuhum waasarroo alnnajwa allatheena thalamoo hal hatha illa basharun mithlukum afatatoona alssihra waantum tubsiroona
verses.saheeh: With their hearts distracted. And those who do wrong conceal their private conversation, [saying], "Is this [Prophet] except a human being like you? So would you approach magic while you are aware [of it]?"
verses.khattab: with their hearts ˹totally˺ distracted. The evildoers would converse secretly, ˹saying,˺ “Is this ˹one˺ not human like yourselves? Would you fall for ˹this˺ witchcraft, even though you can ˹clearly˺ see?”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿with their hearts preoccupied, heedless of its meanings. And they are secret in [their] conference, [their] speech, [they] the evildoers (alladhīna zalamū, a substitution for the [third person plural indicator] wāw of wa-asarrū’l-najwā, ‘and they are secret in conference’) ‘Is this, namely, Muhammad (s), other than a [mortal] human being like yourselves?, and so what he produces is [mere] sorcery. Will you then take [to] sorcery, [will] you [succumb and] follow it, even though you are able to see?’, [even though] you know that it is sorcery?
verses.romanUrdu: Dil unke (dusri hi fikron mein) munhamik hain aur zalim aapas mein sargoshiyan(whisper) karte hain ke “yeh shaks aakhir tum jaisa ek bashar (Insaan) hi to hai, phir kya tum aankhon dekhte jaadu ke phanday mein phas jaogey?”

verses.uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّي يَعۡلَمُ ٱلۡقَوۡلَ فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
verses.indopak: قٰلَ رَبِّىْ يَعْلَمُ الْقَوْلَ فِى السَّمَاۤءِ وَالْاَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ السَّمِيْعُ الْعَلِيْمُ
verses.transliteration: qala rabbee ya'lamu alqawla fee alssamai waalardi wahuwa alssamee'u al'aleemu
verses.saheeh: The Prophet said, "My Lord knows whatever is said throughout the heaven and earth, and He is the Hearing, the Knowing."
verses.khattab: The Prophet responded, “My Lord ˹fully˺ knows every word spoken in the heavens and the earth. For He is the All-Hearing, All-Knowing.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He said, to them, ‘My Lord knows the words, that are [spoken], in the heavens and the earth, and He is the Hearer, of what they keep secret, the Knower’, of it.
verses.romanUrdu: Rasool ne kaha, mera Rubb har us baat ko jaanta hai jo aasman aur zameen mein ki jaye, woh sami(sunne wala) aur aleem (jaanne wala) hai

verses.uthmani: بَلۡ قَالُوٓاْ أَضۡغَٰثُ أَحۡلَٰمِۭ بَلِ ٱفۡتَرَىٰهُ بَلۡ هُوَ شَاعِرٞ فَلۡيَأۡتِنَا بِـَٔايَةٖ كَمَآ أُرۡسِلَ ٱلۡأَوَّلُونَ
verses.indopak: بَلْ قَالُوْۤا اَضْغَاثُ اَحْلَامٍۢ بَلِ افْتَـرٰٮهُ بَلْ هُوَ شَاعِرٌ ۚ فَلْيَأْتِنَا بِاٰيَةٍ كَمَاۤ اُرْسِلَ الْاَوَّلُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: bal qaloo adghathu ahlamin bali iftarahu bal huwa sha'irun falyatina biayatin kama orsila alawwaloona
verses.saheeh: But they say, "[The revelation is but] a mixture of false dreams; rather, he has invented it; rather, he is a poet. So let him bring us a sign just as the previous [messengers] were sent [with miracles]."
verses.khattab: Yet they say, “This ˹Quran˺ is a set of confused dreams! No, he has fabricated it! No, he must be a poet! So let him bring us a ˹tangible˺ sign like those ˹prophets˺ sent before.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Nay (bal, in the three instances [below] effects a transition from one subject to another) but they say, regarding those parts of the Qur'an he [the Prophet] has brought [to them] are: ‘A muddle of nightmares, a confusion [of things] he has seen in [his] sleep. Nay, he has fabricated it, he has invented it; nay, he is a poet, and what he has brought is [merely] poetry! So let him bring us a sign, such as was sent to the ancients’, like the she-camel [Sālih], the staff and the [glowing] hand [of Moses]. God, exalted be He, says:
verses.romanUrdu: Woh kehte hain “balke yeh paraganda (incoherent) khwab hai , balke yeh iski mann-ghadath hai, balke yeh shaks shayar hai warna yeh laye koi nishani jis tarah purane zamane ke Rasool nishaniyon ke saath bheje gaye thay”

verses.uthmani: مَآ ءَامَنَتۡ قَبۡلَهُم مِّن قَرۡيَةٍ أَهۡلَكۡنَٰهَآ ۖ أَفَهُمۡ يُؤۡمِنُونَ
verses.indopak: مَاۤ اٰمَنَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ مِّنْ قَرْيَةٍ اَهْلَـكْنٰهَا ۚ اَفَهُمْ يُؤْمِنُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: ma amanat qablahum min qaryatin ahlaknaha afahum yuminoona
verses.saheeh: Not a [single] city which We destroyed believed before them, so will they believe?
verses.khattab: Not a ˹single˺ society We destroyed before them ever believed ˹after receiving the signs˺. Will these ˹pagans˺ then believe
verses.jalalayn: ﻿No town before them ever believed — meaning [none of] its inhabitants — of those that We destroyed, for the denial of the signs brought to them. Would they then believe? No.
verses.romanUrdu: Halaanke inse pehle koi basti bhi, jisey humne halaak kiya, iman na layi, ab kya yeh iman layenge

verses.uthmani: وَمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا قَبۡلَكَ إِلَّا رِجَالٗا نُّوحِيٓ إِلَيۡهِمۡ ۖ فَسۡـَٔلُوٓاْ أَهۡلَ ٱلذِّكۡرِ إِن كُنتُمۡ لَا تَعۡلَمُونَ
verses.indopak: وَمَاۤ اَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ اِلَّا رِجَالًا نُّوْحِىْۤ اِلَيْهِمْ فَسْـــَٔلُوْۤا اَهْلَ الذِّكْرِ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: wama arsalna qablaka illa rijalan noohee ilayhim faisaloo ahla alththikri in kuntum la ta'lamoona
verses.saheeh: And We sent not before you, [O Muhammad], except men to whom We revealed [the message], so ask the people of the message if you do not know.
verses.khattab: We did not send ˹messengers˺ before you ˹O Prophet˺ except mere men inspired by Us. If you ˹polytheists˺ do not know ˹this already˺, then ask those who have knowledge ˹of the Scriptures˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And We sent none before you other than men to whom We revealed (read nūhī or yūhā, ‘[to whom] it is revealed’) and [We sent] not any angels. Ask the People of the Remembrance, those with knowledge of the Torah and the Gospel, if you do not know, this; for they will know it. Since you are more likely to believe them than the believers are to believing Muhammad (s).
verses.romanUrdu: Aur (aey Muhammad), tumse pehle bhi humne Insaano hi ko Rasool bana kar bheja tha jinpar hum wahee (revelation) kiya karte thay, Tum log agar ilm nahin rakhte to ehle kitaab se pooch lo

verses.uthmani: وَمَا جَعَلۡنَٰهُمۡ جَسَدٗا لَّا يَأۡكُلُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ وَمَا كَانُواْ خَٰلِدِينَ
verses.indopak: وَمَا جَعَلْنٰهُمْ جَسَدًا لَّا يَأْكُلُوْنَ الطَّعَامَ وَمَا كَانُوْا خٰلِدِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: wama ja'alnahum jasadan la yakuloona altta'ama wama kanoo khalideena
verses.saheeh: And We did not make the prophets forms not eating food, nor were they immortal [on earth].
verses.khattab: We did not give those messengers ˹supernatural˺ bodies that did not need food, nor were they immortal
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And We did not make them, namely, the messengers, bodies that did not eat food, nay, they eat it; and they were not immortal, in this world.
verses.romanUrdu: Un Rasoolon ko humne koi aisa jism nahin diya tha ke woh khate na hon, aur na woh sadaa (hamesha) jeenay waley thay

verses.uthmani: ثُمَّ صَدَقۡنَٰهُمُ ٱلۡوَعۡدَ فَأَنجَيۡنَٰهُمۡ وَمَن نَّشَآءُ وَأَهۡلَكۡنَا ٱلۡمُسۡرِفِينَ
verses.indopak: ثُمَّ صَدَقْنٰهُمُ الْوَعْدَ فَاَنْجَيْنٰهُمْ وَمَنْ نَّشَاۤءُ وَاَهْلَكْنَا الْمُسْرِفِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: thumma sadaqnahumu alwa'da faanjaynahum waman nashao waahlakna almusrifeena
verses.saheeh: Then We fulfilled for them the promise, and We saved them and whom We willed and destroyed the transgressors.
verses.khattab: Then We fulfilled Our promise to them, saving them along with whoever We willed and destroying the transgressors
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Then We fulfilled to them the promise, to deliver them. So We delivered them and whomever We would, [of] those who believed in them, and We destroyed the prodigal, those who denied them.
verses.romanUrdu: Phir dekhlo ke aakhir e kaar humne unke saath apne wadey poorey kiye, aur unhein aur jis jis ko humne chaha bacha liya, aur hadd se guzar janey walon ko halaak kardiya

verses.uthmani: لَقَدۡ أَنزَلۡنَآ إِلَيۡكُمۡ كِتَٰبٗا فِيهِ ذِكۡرُكُمۡ ۚ أَفَلَا تَعۡقِلُونَ
verses.indopak: لَقَدْ اَنْزَلْنَاۤ اِلَيْكُمْ كِتٰبًا فِيْهِ ذِكْرُكُمْ ۗ اَفَلَا تَعْقِلُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: laqad anzalna ilaykum kitaban feehi thikrukum afala ta'qiloona
verses.saheeh: We have certainly sent down to you a Book in which is your mention. Then will you not reason?
verses.khattab: We have surely revealed to you a Book, in which there is glory for you. Will you not then understand
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Now We have sent down [as revelation] to you, O clan of Quraysh, a Book in which there is the remembrance that is yours, for it is in your language. Will you not understand?, and so believe in it?
verses.romanUrdu: Logon, humne tumhari taraf ek aisi kitaab bheji hai jismein tumhara hi zikr hai, kya tum samajhte nahin ho

verses.uthmani: وَكَمۡ قَصَمۡنَا مِن قَرۡيَةٖ كَانَتۡ ظَالِمَةٗ وَأَنشَأۡنَا بَعۡدَهَا قَوۡمًا ءَاخَرِينَ
verses.indopak: وَكَمْ قَصَمْنَا مِنْ قَرْيَةٍ كَانَتْ ظَالِمَةً وَّاَنْشَأْنَا بَعْدَهَا قَوْمًا اٰخَرِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: wakam qasamna min qaryatin kanat thalimatan waanshana ba'daha qawman akhareena
verses.saheeh: And how many a city which was unjust have We shattered and produced after it another people.
verses.khattab: ˹Imagine˺ how many societies of wrongdoers We have destroyed, raising up other people after them
verses.jalalayn: And how many did We destroy of towns — meaning its inhabitants — that had been wrongdoing, disbelieving, and brought forth another people after it!
verses.romanUrdu: Kitni hi zalim bastiyan hain jinko humne pees kar rakh diya aur unke baad dusri kisi qaum ko uthaya

verses.uthmani: فَلَمَّآ أَحَسُّواْ بَأۡسَنَآ إِذَا هُم مِّنۡهَا يَرۡكُضُونَ
verses.indopak: فَلَمَّاۤ اَحَسُّوْا بَأْسَنَاۤ اِذَا هُمْ مِّنْهَا يَرْكُضُوْنَ ۗ
verses.transliteration: falamma ahassoo basana itha hum minha yarkudoona
verses.saheeh: And when its inhabitants perceived Our punishment, at once they fled from it.
verses.khattab: When the wrongdoers sensed ˹the arrival of˺ Our torment, they started to run away from their cities
verses.jalalayn: And when they felt Our might, [when] the inhabitants of the town sensed destruction [to be near], behold, they ran away from it, they flee hastily [therefrom].
verses.romanUrdu: Jab unko hamara azaab mehsoos hua to lagey wahan se bhaagne

verses.uthmani: لَا تَرۡكُضُواْ وَٱرۡجِعُوٓاْ إِلَىٰ مَآ أُتۡرِفۡتُمۡ فِيهِ وَمَسَٰكِنِكُمۡ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تُسۡـَٔلُونَ
verses.indopak: لَا تَرْكُضُوْا وَ ارْجِعُوْۤا اِلٰى مَاۤ اُتْرِفْتُمْ فِيْهِ وَمَسٰكِنِكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُسْــَٔلُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: la tarkudoo wairji'oo ila ma otriftum feehi wamasakinikum la'allakum tusaloona
verses.saheeh: [Some angels said], "Do not flee but return to where you were given luxury and to your homes - perhaps you will be questioned."
verses.khattab: ˹They were told,˺ “Do not run away! Return to your luxuries and your homes, so you may be questioned ˹about your fate˺.”
verses.jalalayn: But the angels said to them scornfully: 'Do not run [away]! Return to the opulence, the comforts, which you were given to enjoy and your dwelling-places, that perhaps you might be asked', for something of your worldly possessions as usual.
verses.romanUrdu: (kaha gaya) “bhaago nahin, jao apne unhi gharon mein aur aesh ke samaano mein jinke andar tum chain kar rahey thay, shayad ke tumse poocha jaye”

verses.uthmani: قَالُواْ يَٰوَيۡلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ
verses.indopak: قَالُوْا يٰوَيْلَنَاۤ اِنَّا كُنَّا ظٰلِمِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: qaloo ya waylana inna kunna thalimeena
verses.saheeh: They said, "O woe to us! Indeed, we were wrongdoers."
verses.khattab: They cried, “Woe to us! We have surely been wrongdoers.”
verses.jalalayn: They said, ‘O (yā is for calling attention [to something]) woe to us!, [this is] our destruction! We have indeed been doing wrong’, through [our] disbelief.
verses.romanUrdu: Kehne lagey “haye hamari kambakhti, beshak hum khatawaar thay”

verses.uthmani: فَمَا زَالَت تِّلۡكَ دَعۡوَىٰهُمۡ حَتَّىٰ جَعَلۡنَٰهُمۡ حَصِيدًا خَٰمِدِينَ
verses.indopak: فَمَا زَالَتْ تِّلْكَ دَعْوٰٮهُمْ حَتّٰى جَعَلْنٰهُمْ حَصِيْدًا خٰمِدِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: fama zalat tilka da'wahum hatta ja'alnahum haseedan khamideena
verses.saheeh: And that declaration of theirs did not cease until We made them [as] a harvest [mowed down], extinguished [like a fire].
verses.khattab: They kept repeating their cry until We mowed them down, ˹leaving them˺ lifeless
verses.jalalayn: So that, saying, remained their cry, which they would make and repeat, until We made them as reaped [crops], as crops harvested with sickles when they were killed with the sword, stilled, dead, like the stillness of fire when it is extinguished.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur woh yahi pukarte rahey yahan tak ke humne unko khalyan (threshed/field that is reaped) kardiya , zindagi ka ek sharara tak unmein na raha (leaving no spark of life in them)

verses.uthmani: وَمَا خَلَقۡنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا لَٰعِبِينَ
verses.indopak: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا السَّمَاۤءَ وَالْاَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لٰعِبِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: wama khalaqna alssamaa waalarda wama baynahuma la'ibeena
verses.saheeh: And We did not create the heaven and earth and that between them in play.
verses.khattab: We did not create the heavens and the earth and everything in between for sport
verses.jalalayn: And We did not create the heaven and the earth and all that is between them, playing, being frivolous, but to indicate Our power and to benefit Our servants.
verses.romanUrdu: Humne is aasman aur zameen ko aur jo kuch bhi inmein hai kuch khel ke taur par nahin banaya hai

verses.uthmani: لَوۡ أَرَدۡنَآ أَن نَّتَّخِذَ لَهۡوٗا لَّٱتَّخَذۡنَٰهُ مِن لَّدُنَّآ إِن كُنَّا فَٰعِلِينَ
verses.indopak: لَوْ اَرَدْنَاۤ اَنْ نَّـتَّخِذَ لَهْوًا لَّا تَّخَذْنٰهُ مِنْ لَّدُنَّاۤ ۖ اِنْ كُنَّا فٰعِلِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: law aradna an nattakhitha lahwan laittakhathnahu min ladunna in kunna fa'ileena
verses.saheeh: Had We intended to take a diversion, We could have taken it from [what is] with Us - if [indeed] We were to do so.
verses.khattab: Had We intended to take ˹some˺ amusement, We could have found it in Our presence, if that had been Our Will
verses.jalalayn: Had We desired to find some diversion, that which provides diversion, in the way of a partner or a child, We would have found it with Ourselves, from among the beautiful-eyed houris or angels, were We to do [so]. But We did not do so, thus We never desired it.
verses.romanUrdu: Agar hum koi khilona banan chahte aur bas yahi kuch humein karna hota to apne hi paas se kar letey

verses.uthmani: بَلۡ نَقۡذِفُ بِٱلۡحَقِّ عَلَى ٱلۡبَٰطِلِ فَيَدۡمَغُهُۥ فَإِذَا هُوَ زَاهِقٞ ۚ وَلَكُمُ ٱلۡوَيۡلُ مِمَّا تَصِفُونَ
verses.indopak: بَلْ نَـقْذِفُ بِالْحَـقِّ عَلَى الْبَاطِلِ فَيَدْمَغُهٗ فَاِذَا هُوَ زَاهِقٌ ۗ وَلَـكُمُ الْوَيْلُ مِمَّا تَصِفُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: bal naqthifu bialhaqqi 'ala albatili fayadmaghuhu faitha huwa zahiqun walakumu alwaylu mimma tasifoona
verses.saheeh: Rather, We dash the truth upon falsehood, and it destroys it, and thereupon it departs. And for you is destruction from that which you describe.
verses.khattab: In fact, We hurl the truth against falsehood, leaving it crushed, and it quickly vanishes. And woe be to you for what you claim
verses.jalalayn: Nay, but We hurl, We cast, the truth, faith, against falsehood, disbelief, and it obliterates it, and behold, it vanishes, disappears (damaghahu, ‘it obliterates it’, actually means ‘it struck the brain with a blow’, [a blow] which is fatal). And for you, O disbelievers of Mecca, there shall be woe, severe chastisement, for what you ascribe, to God, of mate or child.
verses.romanUrdu: Magar hum to baatil par haqq ki chot lagate hain jo uska sar todh deti hai aur woh dekhte dekhte mitt jata hai, aur tumhare liye tabahi hai un baaton ki wajah se jo tum banate ho

verses.uthmani: وَلَهُۥ مَن فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ ۚ وَمَنۡ عِندَهُۥ لَا يَسۡتَكۡبِرُونَ عَنۡ عِبَادَتِهِۦ وَلَا يَسۡتَحۡسِرُونَ
verses.indopak: وَلَهٗ مَنْ فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ ۗ وَمَنْ عِنْدَهٗ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُوْنَ عَنْ عِبَادَتِهٖ وَلَا يَسْتَحْسِرُوْنَ ۚ
verses.transliteration: walahu man fee alssamawati waalardi waman 'indahu la yastakbiroona 'an 'ibadatihi wala yastahsiroona
verses.saheeh: To Him belongs whoever is in the heavens and the earth. And those near Him are not prevented by arrogance from His worship, nor do they tire.
verses.khattab: To Him belong all those in the heavens and the earth. And those nearest to Him are not too proud to worship Him, nor do they tire
verses.jalalayn: And to Him, exalted be He, belongs whoever is in the heavens and the earth, as possessions, and those who are near Him, namely, the angels (wa-man ‘indahu, the subject, the predicate of which [is the following clause]) do not disdain to worship Him, nor do they weary.
verses.romanUrdu: Zameen aur aasmano mein jo makhlooq bhi hai Allah ki hai aur jo (Farishtey) uske paas hain woh na apne aap ko bada samajh kar uski bandagi se sartabi karte hain aur na malool (weary /tire) hotey hain

verses.uthmani: يُسَبِّحُونَ ٱلَّيۡلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ لَا يَفۡتُرُونَ
verses.indopak: يُسَبِّحُوْنَ الَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ لَا يَفْتُرُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: yusabbihoona allayla waalnnahara la yafturoona
verses.saheeh: They exalt [Him] night and day [and] do not slacken.
verses.khattab: They glorify ˹Him˺ day and night, never wavering
verses.jalalayn: They glorify [Him] night and day, and they do not falter, in it, for it comes to them as [naturally as] breathing comes to us, [something] which we can never be distracted from.
verses.romanUrdu: Shab-o-roz uski tasbeeh karte rehte hain, dum nahin letey

verses.uthmani: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُوٓاْ ءَالِهَةٗ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ هُمۡ يُنشِرُونَ
verses.indopak: اَمِ اتَّخَذُوْۤا اٰلِهَةً مِّنَ الْاَرْضِ هُمْ يُنْشِرُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: ami ittakhathoo alihatan mina alardi hum yunshiroona
verses.saheeh: Or have men taken for themselves gods from the earth who resurrect [the dead]?
verses.khattab: Or have they taken gods from the earth, who can raise the dead
verses.jalalayn: Or (am, functions with the meaning of bal, ‘nay’, to effect a transition [in subject-matter]; the hamza is for [rhetorical] denial) have they chosen gods, that are, from the earth, such as stones, gold or silver, who, that is, gods [who], resurrect? who bring the dead back to life? No! Indeed only one who brings the dead back to life can be God.
verses.romanUrdu: Kya in logon ke banaye huey arzi khuda aisey hain ke (be-jaan ko jaan baksh kar) utha khada karte hon

verses.uthmani: لَوۡ كَانَ فِيهِمَآ ءَالِهَةٌ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ لَفَسَدَتَا ۚ فَسُبۡحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَرۡشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
verses.indopak: لَوْ كَانَ فِيْهِمَاۤ اٰلِهَةٌ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ لَـفَسَدَتَا ۚ فَسُبْحٰنَ اللّٰهِ رَبِّ الْعَرْشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: law kana feehima alihatun illa allahu lafasadata fasubhana allahi rabbi al'arshi 'amma yasifoona
verses.saheeh: Had there been within the heavens and earth gods besides Allah, they both would have been ruined. So exalted is Allah, Lord of the Throne, above what they describe.
verses.khattab: Had there been other gods besides Allah in the heavens or the earth, both ˹realms˺ would have surely been corrupted. So Glorified is Allah, Lord of the Throne, far above what they claim
verses.jalalayn: Had there been in [either of] them, that is, [in] the heavens and the earth, gods other than God, that is, other than Him, the two would have surely deteriorated, they [the heavens and the earth] would have deviated from their observed order, because counteractive forces would exist among such [gods], as is usually the case, when there is more than one ruler, that there is counteraction and a lack of consensus regarding something. So glory be to God — an exaltation — the Lord, the Creator, of the Throne, al-kursī, above what they ascribe, the disbelievers, to God, of His having a partner and otherwise.
verses.romanUrdu: Agar aasman o zameen mein ek Allah ke siwa dusre khuda bhi hotey to (zameen aur aasman) dono ka nizam bigad jata. Pas paak hai Allah Rabbul arsh un baaton se jo yeh log bana rahey hain

verses.uthmani: لَا يُسۡـَٔلُ عَمَّا يَفۡعَلُ وَهُمۡ يُسۡـَٔلُونَ
verses.indopak: لَا يُسْــَٔـلُ عَمَّا يَفْعَلُ وَهُمْ يُسْـَٔــلُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: la yusalu 'amma yaf'alu wahum yusaloona
verses.saheeh: He is not questioned about what He does, but they will be questioned.
verses.khattab: He cannot be questioned about what He does, but they will ˹all˺ be questioned
verses.jalalayn: He shall not be questioned about what He does, but they shall be questioned, about their actions.
verses.romanUrdu: Woh apne kaamon ke liye (kisi ke aagey) jawab-de nahin hai aur sab jawab-de hain

verses.uthmani: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةٗ ۖ قُلۡ هَاتُواْ بُرۡهَٰنَكُمۡ ۖ هَٰذَا ذِكۡرُ مَن مَّعِيَ وَذِكۡرُ مَن قَبۡلِي ۚ بَلۡ أَكۡثَرُهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ ٱلۡحَقَّ ۖ فَهُم مُّعۡرِضُونَ
verses.indopak: اَمِ اتَّخَذُوْا مِنْ دُوْنِهٖۤ اٰلِهَةً ۗ قُلْ هَاتُوْا بُرْهَانَكُمْ ۚ هٰذَا ذِكْرُ مَنْ مَّعِىَ وَذِكْرُ مَنْ قَبْلِىْ ۗ بَلْ اَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُوْنَ ۙ الْحَـقَّ فَهُمْ مُّعْرِضُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: ami ittakhathoo min doonihi alihatan qul hatoo burhanakum hatha thikru man ma'iya wathikru man qablee bal aktharuhum la ya'lamoona alhaqqa fahum mu'ridoona
verses.saheeh: Or have they taken gods besides Him? Say, [O Muhammad], "Produce your proof. This [Qur'an] is the message for those with me and the message of those before me." But most of them do not know the truth, so they are turning away.
verses.khattab: Or have they taken other gods besides Him? Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Show ˹me˺ your proof. Here is ˹the Quran,˺ the Reminder for those with me; along with ˹earlier Scriptures,˺ the Reminder for those before me.” But most of them do not know the truth, so they turn away
verses.jalalayn: Or have they chosen besides Him, exalted be He, other than Him, gods? (herein is an interrogative meant as a rebuke). Say: ‘Bring your proof, for this — but such a thing is impossible. This is the Remembrance of those with me, namely, my community, and that [Remembrance] is the Qur'an, and the Remembrance of those before me, of communities, namely, the Torah and the Gospel and other Books of God, not a single one of which contains the statement that with God there exists another god, in the way that they claim — exalted be He above such a thing. Nay, but most of them do not know the truth, the affirmation of God’s Oneness, and so they are disregardful’, of that discernment that leads to [knowledge of] it.
verses.romanUrdu: Kya usey chodh kar inhon ne dusre khuda bana liye hain? (Aey Muhammad) inse kaho ke “lao apni daleel,yeh kitaab bhi maujood hai jismein mere daur ke logon ke liye naseehat hai aur woh kitaabein bhi maujood hain jin mein mujhse pehle logon ke liye naseehat thi” magar un mein se aksar log haqeeqat se bekhabar hain, is liye mooh moadey huey hain

verses.uthmani: وَمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مِن قَبۡلِكَ مِن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا نُوحِيٓ إِلَيۡهِ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱعۡبُدُونِ
verses.indopak: وَمَاۤ اَرْسَلْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِكَ مِنْ رَّسُوْلٍ اِلَّا نُوْحِىْۤ اِلَيْهِ اَنَّهٗ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّاۤ اَنَا۠ فَاعْبُدُوْنِ
verses.transliteration: wama arsalna min qablika min rasoolin illa noohee ilayhi annahu la ilaha illa ana fao'budooni
verses.saheeh: And We sent not before you any messenger except that We revealed to him that, "There is no deity except Me, so worship Me."
verses.khattab: We never sent a messenger before you ˹O Prophet˺ without revealing to him: “There is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Me, so worship Me ˹alone˺.”
verses.jalalayn: And We did not send any Messenger before you but We revealed to him (read nūhī or yūhā, ‘[but] it was revealed to him’) that, ‘There is no god except Me, so worship Me’, that is, affirm My Oneness.
verses.romanUrdu: Humne tumse pehle jo Rasool bhi bheja hai usko yahi wahee ki hai ke mere siwa koi khuda nahin hai, pas tumlog meri hi bandagi karo

verses.uthmani: وَقَالُواْ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ وَلَدٗا ۗ سُبۡحَٰنَهُۥ ۚ بَلۡ عِبَادٞ مُّكۡرَمُونَ
verses.indopak: وَقَالُوا اتَّخَذَ الرَّحْمٰنُ وَلَدًا سُبْحٰنَهٗ ۗ بَلْ عِبَادٌ مُّكْرَمُوْنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: waqaloo ittakhatha alrrahmanu waladan subhanahu bal 'ibadun mukramoona
verses.saheeh: And they say, "The Most Merciful has taken a son." Exalted is He! Rather, they are [but] honored servants.
verses.khattab: And they say, “The Most Compassionate has offspring!” Glory be to Him! In fact, those ˹angels˺ are only ˹His˺ honoured servants
verses.jalalayn: And they say, ‘The Compassionate One has taken a son’, from the angels. Glory be to Him! Nay, but they are [merely] servants who are honoured, in His presence; for [the very] servitude [of all creatures to Him] is inconsistent with [the attribution of any of them as] progeny [of His].
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh kehte hain “rehman aulad rakhta hai” SubhanAllah , woh to banday hain jinhein izzat di gayi hai

verses.uthmani: لَا يَسۡبِقُونَهُۥ بِٱلۡقَوۡلِ وَهُم بِأَمۡرِهِۦ يَعۡمَلُونَ
verses.indopak: لَا يَسْبِقُوْنَهٗ بِالْقَوْلِ وَهُمْ بِاَمْرِهٖ يَعْمَلُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: la yasbiqoonahu bialqawli wahum biamrihi ya'maloona
verses.saheeh: They cannot precede Him in word, and they act by His command.
verses.khattab: who do not speak until He has spoken, ˹only˺ acting at His command
verses.jalalayn: They do not [venture to] speak before Him — they only speak after He has spoken, and they act according to His command, that is, following [His issuing of] it.
verses.romanUrdu: Uske huzoor badh kar nahin bolte aur bas uske hukum par amal karte hain

verses.uthmani: يَعۡلَمُ مَا بَيۡنَ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ وَمَا خَلۡفَهُمۡ وَلَا يَشۡفَعُونَ إِلَّا لِمَنِ ٱرۡتَضَىٰ وَهُم مِّنۡ خَشۡيَتِهِۦ مُشۡفِقُونَ
verses.indopak: يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ اَيْدِيْهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَ لَا يَشْفَعُوْنَ ۙ اِلَّا لِمَنِ ارْتَضٰى وَهُمْ مِّنْ خَشْيَـتِهٖ مُشْفِقُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: ya'lamu ma bayna aydeehim wama khalfahum wala yashfa'oona illa limani irtada wahum min khashyatihi mushfiqoona
verses.saheeh: He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, and they cannot intercede except on behalf of one whom He approves. And they, from fear of Him, are apprehensive.
verses.khattab: He ˹fully˺ knows what is ahead of them and what is behind them. They do not intercede except for whom He approves, and they tremble in awe of Him
verses.jalalayn: He knows what is before them and what is behind them, that is, what they have done and what they will do, and they do not intercede except for him with whom He is satisfied, that he be interceded for, and they, for awe of Him, exalted be He, are apprehensive, fearful.
verses.romanUrdu: Jo kuch unke saamne hai usey bhi woh jaanta hai aur jo kuch unse ojhal hai ussey bhi woh bakhabar hai, woh kisi ki sifarish nahin karte bajuz uske jiske haqq mein sifarish sunne par Allah raazi ho, aur woh uske khauf se darey rehte hain

verses.uthmani: ۞ وَمَن يَقُلۡ مِنۡهُمۡ إِنِّيٓ إِلَٰهٞ مِّن دُونِهِۦ فَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِيهِ جَهَنَّمَ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
verses.indopak: ۞ وَمَنْ يَّقُلْ مِنْهُمْ اِنِّىْۤ اِلٰـهٌ مِّنْ دُوْنِهٖ فَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِيْهِ جَهَـنَّمَ ۗ كَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِى الظّٰلِمِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: waman yaqul minhum innee ilahun min doonihi fathalika najzeehi jahannama kathalika najzee alththalimeena
verses.saheeh: And whoever of them should say, "Indeed, I am a god besides Him"- that one We would recompense with Hell. Thus do We recompense the wrongdoers.
verses.khattab: Whoever of them were to say, “I am a god besides Him,” they would be rewarded with Hell by Us. This is how We reward the wrongdoers
verses.jalalayn: And should any of them say, ‘I am a god besides Him’, that is, [besides] God, in other words, [a god] other than Him — and this is Iblīs, who summoned [others] to worship his soul and commanded that it be obeyed — such a one We will requite with Hell. Thus, in the same way that We requite him, We requite wrong-doers, idolaters.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur jo unmein se koi kehde ke Allah ke siwa main bhi ek khuda hoon, to usey hum jahannum ki saza dein, hamare haan zaalimon ka yahi badla hai

verses.uthmani: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ أَنَّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ كَانَتَا رَتۡقٗا فَفَتَقۡنَٰهُمَا ۖ وَجَعَلۡنَا مِنَ ٱلۡمَآءِ كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ حَيٍّ ۚ أَفَلَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ
verses.indopak: اَوَلَمْ يَرَ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْۤا اَنَّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضَ كَانَـتَا رَتْقًا فَفَتَقْنٰهُمَا ۗ وَجَعَلْنَا مِنَ الْمَاۤءِ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ حَىٍّ ۗ اَفَلَا يُؤْمِنُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: awalam yara allatheena kafaroo anna alssamawati waalarda kanata ratqan fafataqnahuma waja'alna mina almai kulla shayin hayyin afala yuminoona
verses.saheeh: Have those who disbelieved not considered that the heavens and the earth were a joined entity, and We separated them and made from water every living thing? Then will they not believe?
verses.khattab: Do the disbelievers not realize that the heavens and earth were ˹once˺ one mass then We split them apart? And We created from water every living thing. Will they not then believe
verses.jalalayn: Have they not ([one may] read a-wa-lam or a-lam) realised, [have they not] come to know, those who disbelieve, that the heavens and the earth were closed together and then We parted them, We made seven heavens and seven earths — or [it is meant] that the heaven was parted and began to rain, when it did not use to do so, and that the earth was parted and began to produce plants, when it did not use to do so; and We made, of water, [the water] that falls from the heaven and that springs from the earth, every living thing?, in the way of plants and otherwise: in other words, water is the cause of such [things] having life. Will they not then believe?, by affirming My Oneness?
verses.romanUrdu: Kya yeh log jinhon ne (Nabi ki baat maanney se) inkar kardiya hai gaur nahin karte ke yeh sab aasman aur zameen baham miley huey thay, phir humne inhein juda kiya, aur pani se har zinda cheez paida ki, kya woh (hamari is khallaqi ko) nahin maante

verses.uthmani: وَجَعَلۡنَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ رَوَٰسِيَ أَن تَمِيدَ بِهِمۡ وَجَعَلۡنَا فِيهَا فِجَاجٗا سُبُلٗا لَّعَلَّهُمۡ يَهۡتَدُونَ
verses.indopak: وَجَعَلْنَا فِى الْاَرْضِ رَوَاسِىَ اَنْ تَمِيْدَ بِهِمْ ۖ وَجَعَلْنَا فِيْهَا فِجَاجًا سُبُلًا لَّعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: waja'alna fee alardi rawasiya an tameeda bihim waja'alna feeha fijajan subulan la'allahum yahtadoona
verses.saheeh: And We placed within the earth firmly set mountains, lest it should shift with them, and We made therein [mountain] passes [as] roads that they might be guided.
verses.khattab: And We have placed firm mountains upon the earth so it does not shake with them, and made in it broad pathways so they may find their way
verses.jalalayn: And We set in the earth firm mountains lest it should shake with them, and We set in them, [in] the firm mountains, ravines, as roads (subulan substitutes [for fijājan, ‘ravines’, which are wide through-routes]), that perhaps they may be guided, to their destinations during travel.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur humne zameen mein pahad jamaa diye taa-ke woh unhein lekar dhulak na jaye, aur ismein kushada raahein bana di, shayad ke log apna raasta maloom karlein

verses.uthmani: وَجَعَلۡنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ سَقۡفٗا مَّحۡفُوظٗا ۖ وَهُمۡ عَنۡ ءَايَٰتِهَا مُعۡرِضُونَ
verses.indopak: وَجَعَلْنَا السَّمَاۤءَ سَقْفًا مَّحْفُوْظًا ۚ وَهُمْ عَنْ اٰيٰتِهَا مُعْرِضُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: waja'alna alssamaa saqfan mahfoothan wahum 'an ayatiha mu'ridoona
verses.saheeh: And We made the sky a protected ceiling, but they, from its signs, are turning away.
verses.khattab: And We have made the sky a well-protected canopy, still they turn away from its signs
verses.jalalayn: And We made the heaven a roof, for the earth, [functioning] like the roof of a house, preserved, from collapsing; and yet of the signs thereof, namely, [the signs of this heaven such as] the sun, the moon and the stars, they are disregardful, failing to reflect on them and thus realise that the Creator of such [things] can have no partner.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur humne aasman ko ek mehfooz chatt bana diya, magar ye hain ke iski nishaniyon ki taraf tawajju hi nahin karte

verses.uthmani: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلَّيۡلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ وَٱلشَّمۡسَ وَٱلۡقَمَرَ ۖ كُلّٞ فِي فَلَكٖ يَسۡبَحُونَ
verses.indopak: وَهُوَ الَّذِىْ خَلَقَ الَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ وَالشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ ۗ كُلٌّ فِىْ فَلَكٍ يَّسْبَحُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: wahuwa allathee khalaqa allayla waalnnahara waalshshamsa waalqamara kullun fee falakin yasbahoona
verses.saheeh: And it is He who created the night and the day and the sun and the moon; all [heavenly bodies] in an orbit are swimming.
verses.khattab: And He is the One Who created the day and the night, the sun and the moon—each travelling in an orbit
verses.jalalayn: And He it is Who created the night and the day, and the sun and the moon, each (kullun, the nunation of this [particle] stands in place of the second noun [of the genitive construction] that would have been al-shams, ‘the sun’, or al-qamar, ‘the moon’, or their subsidiaries, namely, al-nujūm, ‘the stars’) in an orbit, a circular [one] like a mill in the sky, swimming, moving with speed, like a swimmer in water. In order to effect the analogy with the latter, the plural person [of the verb employed] for rational beings is used.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur woh Allah hi hai jisne raat aur din banaye aur Suraj aur Chand ko paida kiya, sab ek ek falak mein tair rahey hain

verses.uthmani: وَمَا جَعَلۡنَا لِبَشَرٖ مِّن قَبۡلِكَ ٱلۡخُلۡدَ ۖ أَفَإِيْن مِّتَّ فَهُمُ ٱلۡخَٰلِدُونَ
verses.indopak: وَمَا جَعَلْنَا لِبَشَرٍ مِّنْ قَبْلِكَ الْخُـلْدَ ۗ اَفَا۟ٮِٕنْ مِّتَّ فَهُمُ الْخٰـلِدُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: wama ja'alna libasharin min qablika alkhulda afain mitta fahumu alkhalidoona
verses.saheeh: And We did not grant to any man before you eternity [on earth]; so if you die - would they be eternal?
verses.khattab: We have not granted immortality to any human before you ˹O Prophet˺: so if you die, will they live forever
verses.jalalayn: When the disbelievers said that Muhammad (s) would die, the following was revealed: And We did not assign to any human being before you immortality, permanence [of life] in this world. What, if you [are fated to] die, will they be immortal?, in it? No! (The last sentence constitutes the [syntactical] locus of the interrogative of denial).
verses.romanUrdu: Aur (aey Muhammad), hameshgi(eternity) to humne tumse pehle bhi kisi Insaan ke liye nahin rakkhi hai agar tum mar gaye to kya yeh log hamesha jeetay rahenge

verses.uthmani: كُلُّ نَفۡسٖ ذَآئِقَةُ ٱلۡمَوۡتِ ۗ وَنَبۡلُوكُم بِٱلشَّرِّ وَٱلۡخَيۡرِ فِتۡنَةٗ ۖ وَإِلَيۡنَا تُرۡجَعُونَ
verses.indopak: كُلُّ نَفْسٍ ذَاۤٮِٕقَةُ الْمَوْتِ ۗ وَنَبْلُوْكُمْ بِالشَّرِّ وَالْخَيْرِ فِتْنَةً ۗ وَاِلَيْنَا تُرْجَعُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: kullu nafsin thaiqatu almawti wanablookum bialshsharri waalkhayri fitnatan wailayna turja'oona
verses.saheeh: Every soul will taste death. And We test you with evil and with good as trial; and to Us you will be returned.
verses.khattab: Every soul will taste death. And We test you ˹O humanity˺ with good and evil as a trial, then to Us you will ˹all˺ be returned
verses.jalalayn: Every soul shall taste death, in this world, and We will try you, We will test you, with ill and good, such as poverty and wealth, sickness and health, as an ordeal (fitnatan, an object denoting reason, in other words, for the purpose of seeing whether you will be patient and give thanks or not). And then unto Us you shall be brought back, that We may requite you.
verses.romanUrdu: Har jaandaar ko maut ka maza chakhna hai, aur hum acchey aur burey halaat mein daal kar tum sabki aazmaish kar rahey hain, aakhir-e-kaar tumhein hamari hi taraf palatna hai

verses.uthmani: وَإِذَا رَءَاكَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ إِن يَتَّخِذُونَكَ إِلَّا هُزُوًا أَهَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي يَذۡكُرُ ءَالِهَتَكُمۡ وَهُم بِذِكۡرِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ هُمۡ كَٰفِرُونَ
verses.indopak: وَاِذَا رَاٰكَ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْۤا اِنْ يَّتَّخِذُوْنَكَ اِلَّا هُزُوًا ۗ اَهٰذَا الَّذِىْ يَذْكُرُ اٰلِهَـتَكُمْ ۚ وَهُمْ بِذِكْرِ الرَّحْمٰنِ هُمْ كٰفِرُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: waitha raaka allatheena kafaroo in yattakhithoonaka illa huzuwan ahatha allathee yathkuru alihatakum wahum bithikri alrrahmani hum kafiroona
verses.saheeh: And when those who disbelieve see you, [O Muhammad], they take you not except in ridicule, [saying], "Is this the one who insults your gods?" And they are, at the mention of the Most Merciful, disbelievers.
verses.khattab: When the disbelievers see you ˹O Prophet˺, they only make fun of you, ˹saying,˺ “Is this the one who speaks ˹ill˺ of your gods?” while they disbelieve at the mention of the Most Compassionate
verses.jalalayn: And whenever the disbelievers see you, they only take you in derision, that is, as one to be derided, saying: ‘Is this the one who mentions your gods?’, that is, [the one who] derides them? And yet when it comes to the mention of the Compassionate One, to them, they (hum, [repeated] for emphasis) are disbelieving, of it, saying, ‘We do not know of any such [individual]’.
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh munkireen e haqq jab tumhein dekhte hain to tumhara mazaaq bana letey hain. Kehte hain “kya yeh hai woh shaks jo tumhare khudaon ka zikr kiya karta hai?” aur inka apna haal yeh hai ke rehman ke zikr se munkir hain

verses.uthmani: خُلِقَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ مِنۡ عَجَلٖ ۚ سَأُوْرِيكُمۡ ءَايَٰتِي فَلَا تَسۡتَعۡجِلُونِ
verses.indopak: خُلِقَ الْاِنْسَانُ مِنْ عَجَلٍ ۗ سَاُورِيْكُمْ اٰيٰتِىْ فَلَا تَسْتَعْجِلُوْنِ
verses.transliteration: khuliqa alinsanu min 'ajalin saoreekum ayatee fala tasta'jiloona
verses.saheeh: Man was created of haste. I will show you My signs, so do not impatiently urge Me.
verses.khattab: Humankind is made of haste. I will soon show you My signs, so do not ask Me to hasten them
verses.jalalayn: The following was revealed regarding their demand that chastisement be hastened: Man was created of haste, that is to say, because he is so hasty in his affairs, it is as if he had been created out of it. Assuredly I shall show you My signs, My promises of chastisement, so do not demand that I hasten, in [sending] it. And so He [God] made them suffer death at [the battle of] Badr.
verses.romanUrdu: Insaan jald baaz makhlooq hai, abhi main tumko apni nishaniyan dikhaye deta hoon, jaldi na machao

verses.uthmani: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلۡوَعۡدُ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
verses.indopak: وَيَقُوْلُوْنَ مَتٰى هٰذَا الْوَعْدُ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ صٰدِقِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: wayaqooloona mata hatha alwa'du in kuntum sadiqeena
verses.saheeh: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"
verses.khattab: They ask ˹the believers˺, “When will this threat come to pass if what you say is true?”
verses.jalalayn: And they say, ‘When will this promise, of resurrection, be [fulfilled], if you are truthful?’, about it.
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh log kehte hain “aakhir yeh dhamki poori kab hogi agar tum sacchey ho”

verses.uthmani: لَوۡ يَعۡلَمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ حِينَ لَا يَكُفُّونَ عَن وُجُوهِهِمُ ٱلنَّارَ وَلَا عَن ظُهُورِهِمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يُنصَرُونَ
verses.indopak: لَوْ يَعْلَمُ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا حِيْنَ لَا يَكُفُّوْنَ عَنْ وُّجُوْهِهِمُ النَّارَ وَلَا عَنْ ظُهُوْرِهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنْصَرُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: law ya'lamu allatheena kafaroo heena la yakuffoona 'an wujoohihimu alnnara wala 'an thuhoorihim wala hum yunsaroona
verses.saheeh: If those who disbelieved but knew the time when they will not avert the Fire from their faces or from their backs and they will not be aided...
verses.khattab: If only the disbelievers knew that a time will come when they will not be able to keep the Fire off their faces or backs, nor will they be helped
verses.jalalayn: [God] exalted be He, says: If those who disbelieved only knew of the time when they shall not [be able to] ward off, repel, the Fire from their faces, nor from their backs, nor shall they be helped, [nor] shall they be protected from it at the Resurrection (the response to the [conditional particle] law, ‘if only’, is [something along the lines of] ‘they would not have said that’).
verses.romanUrdu: Kaash in kaafiron ko us waqt ka kuch ilam hota jabke yeh na apne mooh aag se bacha sakenge na apni peethein, aur na inko kahin se madad pahunchegi

verses.uthmani: بَلۡ تَأۡتِيهِم بَغۡتَةٗ فَتَبۡهَتُهُمۡ فَلَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ رَدَّهَا وَلَا هُمۡ يُنظَرُونَ
verses.indopak: بَلْ تَأْتِيْهِمْ بَغْتَةً فَتَبْهَتُهُمْ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيْعُوْنَ رَدَّهَا وَلَا هُمْ يُنْظَرُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: bal tateehim baghtatan fatabhatuhum fala yastatee'oona raddaha wala hum yuntharoona
verses.saheeh: Rather, it will come to them unexpectedly and bewilder them, and they will not be able to repel it, nor will they be reprieved.
verses.khattab: In fact, the Hour will take them by surprise, leaving them stunned. So they will not be able to avert it, nor will it be delayed from them
verses.jalalayn: Nay, but it, the Resurrection, shall come upon them suddenly, dumbfounding them, confusing them, and they shall not be able to ward it off, nor shall they be granted any respite, [nor shall they] be given any [extra] time to make a repentance or offer an excuse.
verses.romanUrdu: Woh balaa (catastrophe) achanak aayegi aur inhein is tarah yaklakht (suddenly) daboch legi ke yeh na usko dafaa kar sakenge aur na inko lamha bhar mohlat hi mil sakegi

verses.uthmani: وَلَقَدِ ٱسۡتُهۡزِئَ بِرُسُلٖ مِّن قَبۡلِكَ فَحَاقَ بِٱلَّذِينَ سَخِرُواْ مِنۡهُم مَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ
verses.indopak: وَلَـقَدِ اسْتُهْزِئَ بِرُسُلٍ مِّنْ قَبْلِكَ فَحَاقَ بِالَّذِيْنَ سَخِرُوْا مِنْهُمْ مَّا كَانُوْا بِهٖ يَسْتَهْزِءُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: walaqadi istuhzia birusulin min qablika fahaqa biallatheena sakhiroo minhum ma kanoo bihi yastahzioona
verses.saheeh: And already were messengers ridiculed before you, but those who mocked them were enveloped by what they used to ridicule.
verses.khattab: ˹Other˺ messengers had already been ridiculed before you ˹O Prophet˺, but those who mocked them were overtaken by what they used to ridicule
verses.jalalayn: And verily messengers before you were derided — herein is a statement to comfort the Prophet (s) — but those who mocked them were encircled by, it was sent down [against them], that which they used to deride, namely, chastisement — likewise it shall befall those who have derided you.
verses.romanUrdu: Mazaaq tumse pehle bhi Rasoolon ka udaya jaa chuka hai, magar unka mazaaq udane waley usi cheez ke pher mein aa kar rahey jiska woh mazaaq udatey thay

verses.uthmani: قُلۡ مَن يَكۡلَؤُكُم بِٱلَّيۡلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ مِنَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ ۚ بَلۡ هُمۡ عَن ذِكۡرِ رَبِّهِم مُّعۡرِضُونَ
verses.indopak: قُلْ مَنْ يَّكْلَـؤُكُمْ بِالَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ مِنَ الرَّحْمٰنِ ۗ بَلْ هُمْ عَنْ ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِمْ مُّعْرِضُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: qul man yaklaokum biallayli waalnnahari mina alrrahmani bal hum 'an thikri rabbihim mu'ridoona
verses.saheeh: Say, "Who can protect you at night or by day from the Most Merciful?" But they are, from the remembrance of their Lord, turning away.
verses.khattab: Ask ˹them, O Prophet,˺ “Who can defend you by day or by night against the Most Compassionate?” Still they turn away from the remembrance of their Lord
verses.jalalayn: Say, to them: ‘Who can guard you, preserve you, by night and day from the Compassionate One?’, from His chastisement, if it should befall you? In other words, no one can do such a thing. Those being addressed [here] do not fear God’s chastisement because they deny [the truth of] it. Nay, but of the Remembrance of their Lord, that is, the Qur'an, they are disregardful, failing to reflect on it.
verses.romanUrdu: (Aey Muhammad), insey kaho, “kaun hai jo raat ko ya din ko tumhein rehman se bacha sakta ho?” magar yeh apne Rubb ki naseehat se mooh moad rahey hain

verses.uthmani: أَمۡ لَهُمۡ ءَالِهَةٞ تَمۡنَعُهُم مِّن دُونِنَا ۚ لَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ نَصۡرَ أَنفُسِهِمۡ وَلَا هُم مِّنَّا يُصۡحَبُونَ
verses.indopak: اَمْ لَهُمْ اٰلِهَةٌ تَمْنَعُهُمْ مِّنْ دُوْنِنَا ۗ لَا يَسْتَطِيْعُوْنَ نَـصْرَ اَنْفُسِهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ مِّنَّا يُصْحَبُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: am lahum alihatun tamna'uhum min doonina la yastatee'oona nasra anfusihim wala hum minna yushaboona
verses.saheeh: Or do they have gods to defend them other than Us? They are unable [even] to help themselves, nor can they be protected from Us.
verses.khattab: Or do they have gods—other than Us—that can protect them? They cannot ˹even˺ protect themselves, nor will they be aided against Us
verses.jalalayn: Or is it that they have (am, ‘or’, functions with the sense of a hamza used to indicate denial, that is, [read it as] a-lahum, ‘do they have’) gods to defend them, against that which might cause them harm, besides Us? In other words, do they have anyone other than Us to defend them against such [things]? No! They, namely, the gods, cannot help themselves, and so they will not [be able to] help them; nor shall they, the disbelievers, be protected from Us, from Our chastisement (one may say sahibaka’Llāhu, to mean ‘May God preserve and protect you’).
verses.romanUrdu: Kya yeh kuch aise khuda rakhte hain jo hamare muqable mein inki himayat karein? Woh na to khud apni madad kar sakte hain aur na hamari hi taaeed unko haasil hai

verses.uthmani: بَلۡ مَتَّعۡنَا هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَءَابَآءَهُمۡ حَتَّىٰ طَالَ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلۡعُمُرُ ۗ أَفَلَا يَرَوۡنَ أَنَّا نَأۡتِي ٱلۡأَرۡضَ نَنقُصُهَا مِنۡ أَطۡرَافِهَآ ۚ أَفَهُمُ ٱلۡغَٰلِبُونَ
verses.indopak: بَلْ مَتَّـعْنَا هٰۤؤُلَاۤءِ وَ اٰبَاۤءَهُمْ حَتّٰى طَالَ عَلَيْهِمُ الْعُمُرُ ۗ اَفَلَا يَرَوْنَ اَنَّا نَأْتِى الْاَرْضَ نَـنْقُصُهَا مِنْ اَطْرَافِهَا ۗ اَفَهُمُ الْغٰلِبُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: bal matta'na haolai waabaahum hatta tala 'alayhimu al'umuru afala yarawna anna natee alarda nanqusuha min atrafiha afahumu alghaliboona
verses.saheeh: But, [on the contrary], We have provided good things for these [disbelievers] and their fathers until life was prolonged for them. Then do they not see that We set upon the land, reducing it from its borders? So it is they who will overcome?
verses.khattab: In fact, We have allowed enjoyment for these ˹Meccans˺ and their forefathers for such a long time ˹that they took it for granted˺. Do they not see that We gradually reduce ˹their˺ land from its borders? Is it they who will then prevail
verses.jalalayn: Nay, but We provided [comforts] for these and their fathers, in the way of the graces which We bestowed on them, until life lasted long for them, so that they were deluded by such [longevity]. Do they not see how We visit the land, [how] We target their land, diminishing it at its edges?, by granting the Prophet victory [through conquest]. Are they the ones who will prevail? No, it is rather the Prophet and his Companions [who will do so].
verses.romanUrdu: Asal baat yeh hai ke in logon ko aur inke aabaa o ajdaad (fore-fathers) ko hum zindagi ka sar o saamaan diye chale gaye yahan tak ke inko din lag gaye (until the period grew too long for them). Magar kya inhein nazar nahin aata ke hum zameen ko mukhtalif simton se ghataye chale aa rahey hain (shrinking its boundaries)? Phir kya yeh gaalib aa jayenge

verses.uthmani: قُلۡ إِنَّمَآ أُنذِرُكُم بِٱلۡوَحۡيِ ۚ وَلَا يَسۡمَعُ ٱلصُّمُّ ٱلدُّعَآءَ إِذَا مَا يُنذَرُونَ
verses.indopak: قُلْ اِنَّمَاۤ اُنْذِرُكُمْ بِالْوَحْىِ ۖ وَلَا يَسْمَعُ الصُّمُّ الدُّعَاۤءَ اِذَا مَا يُنْذَرُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: qul innama onthirukum bialwahyi wala yasma'u alssummu alddu'aa itha ma yuntharoona
verses.saheeh: Say, "I only warn you by revelation." But the deaf do not hear the call when they are warned.
verses.khattab: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “I warn you only by revelation.” But the deaf cannot hear the call when they are warned
verses.jalalayn: Say, to them: ‘I warn you only by the Revelation’, [that comes] from God, and not by my own prompting. But the deaf do not hear the call when (idhā, read pronouncing both hamzas fully, or omitting the second [hamza] between it and the yā’) they are warned. They are like those who are deaf, when they fail to act in accordance with the warnings they hear.
verses.romanUrdu: Inse kehdo ke “main to wahee (revelation) ki bina par tumhein mutanabbeh (warn) kar raha hoon”. Magar behre pukaar ko nahin suna karte jabke unhein khabardaar kiya jaye

verses.uthmani: وَلَئِن مَّسَّتۡهُمۡ نَفۡحَةٞ مِّنۡ عَذَابِ رَبِّكَ لَيَقُولُنَّ يَٰوَيۡلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ
verses.indopak: وَلَٮِٕنْ مَّسَّتْهُمْ نَفْحَةٌ مِّنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّكَ لَيَقُوْلُنَّ يٰوَيْلَنَاۤ اِنَّا كُنَّا ظٰلِمِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: walain massathum nafhatun min 'athabi rabbika layaqoolunna ya waylana inna kunna thalimeena
verses.saheeh: And if [as much as] a whiff of the punishment of your Lord should touch them, they would surely say, "O woe to us! Indeed, we have been wrongdoers."
verses.khattab: If they were touched by even a breath of your Lord’s torment, they would certainly cry, “Woe to us! We have really been wrongdoers.”
verses.jalalayn: And if a whiff, a slight instance, of your Lord’s chastisement were to touch them, they would indeed say, ‘O (yā, used for drawing attention [to something]) woe for us!, [O this is] our destruction! Truly we were doing evil’, in ascribing partners to God and denying [the Mission of] Muhammad (s).
verses.romanUrdu: Aur agar tere Rubb ka azaab zara sa inhein choo jaye to abhi cheekh utthein ke haaye hamari kambakhti, beshak hum khatawaar thay

verses.uthmani: وَنَضَعُ ٱلۡمَوَٰزِينَ ٱلۡقِسۡطَ لِيَوۡمِ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ فَلَا تُظۡلَمُ نَفۡسٞ شَيۡـٔٗا ۖ وَإِن كَانَ مِثۡقَالَ حَبَّةٖ مِّنۡ خَرۡدَلٍ أَتَيۡنَا بِهَا ۗ وَكَفَىٰ بِنَا حَٰسِبِينَ
verses.indopak: وَنَضَعُ الْمَوَازِيْنَ الْقِسْطَ لِيَوْمِ الْقِيٰمَةِ فَلَا تُظْلَمُ نَـفْسٌ شَيْــًٔـا ۗ وَاِنْ كَانَ مِثْقَالَ حَبَّةٍ مِّنْ خَرْدَلٍ اَتَيْنَا بِهَا ۗ وَكَفٰى بِنَا حٰسِبِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: wanada'u almawazeena alqista liyawmi alqiyamati fala tuthlamu nafsun shayan wain kana mithqala habbatin min khardalin atayna biha wakafa bina hasibeena
verses.saheeh: And We place the scales of justice for the Day of Resurrection, so no soul will be treated unjustly at all. And if there is [even] the weight of a mustard seed, We will bring it forth. And sufficient are We as accountant.
verses.khattab: We will set up the scales of justice on the Day of Judgment, so no soul will be wronged in the least. And ˹even˺ if a deed is the weight of a mustard seed, We will bring it forth. And sufficient are We as a ˹vigilant˺ Reckoner
verses.jalalayn: And We shall set up the just balances, the equitable ones, for the Day of Resurrection, that is, on it, and no soul shall be wronged in any way, neither by deducting a good deed [from its record], nor by adding [to it] an evil one; and even if it, the action, be the weight of a [single] mustard seed, We shall produce it, with its full weight, and We suffice as reckoners, to count all things.
verses.romanUrdu: Qayamat ke roz hum theek theek toalne waley tarazu rakh dengey, phir kisi shaks par zarra barabar zulm na hoga. Jiska rai (mustard seed) ke daane ke barabar bhi kuch kiya dhara hoga woh hum saamne le aayenge aur hisaab lagane ke liye hum kafi hain

verses.uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ ءَاتَيۡنَا مُوسَىٰ وَهَٰرُونَ ٱلۡفُرۡقَانَ وَضِيَآءٗ وَذِكۡرٗا لِّلۡمُتَّقِينَ
verses.indopak: وَلَـقَدْ اٰتَيْنَا مُوْسٰى وَهٰرُوْنَ الْفُرْقَانَ وَضِيَاۤءً وَّذِكْرًا لِّـلْمُتَّقِيْنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: walaqad atayna moosa waharoona alfurqana wadiyaan wathikran lilmuttaqeena
verses.saheeh: And We had already given Moses and Aaron the criterion and a light and a reminder for the righteous
verses.khattab: Indeed, We granted Moses and Aaron the standard ˹to distinguish between right and wrong˺—a light and a reminder for the righteous
verses.jalalayn: And verily We gave Moses and Aaron the Criterion, the Torah that discriminates between truth and falsehood, and [between] what is lawful and unlawful, and an illumination, by it, and remembrance, an admonition therein, for those who are wary of God,
verses.romanUrdu: Pehle hum Moosa aur Haroon ko furqan(criteria) aur roshni aur “zikr” ata kar chuke hain un muttaqi logon ki bhalayi ke liye

verses.uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يَخۡشَوۡنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلۡغَيۡبِ وَهُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّاعَةِ مُشۡفِقُونَ
verses.indopak: الَّذِيْنَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ بِالْغَيْبِ وَهُمْ مِّنَ السَّاعَةِ مُشْفِقُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: allatheena yakhshawna rabbahum bialghaybi wahum mina alssa'ati mushfiqoona
verses.saheeh: Who fear their Lord unseen, while they are of the Hour apprehensive.
verses.khattab: who are in awe of their Lord without seeing Him, and are fearful of the Hour
verses.jalalayn: those who fear their Lord in concealment, from people, that is, when they are in seclusion from them, and who, on account of the Hour, that is, [on account of] its terrors, are apprehensive, fearful.
verses.romanUrdu: Jo bay-dekhe (bagair dekhe) apne Rubb se darein aur jinko (hisaab ki) us ghadi ka khatka laga hua hai

verses.uthmani: وَهَٰذَا ذِكۡرٞ مُّبَارَكٌ أَنزَلۡنَٰهُ ۚ أَفَأَنتُمۡ لَهُۥ مُنكِرُونَ
verses.indopak: وَهٰذَا ذِكْرٌ مُّبٰرَكٌ اَنْزَلْنٰهُ ۗ اَفَاَنْتُمْ لَهٗ مُنْكِرُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: wahatha thikrun mubarakun anzalnahu afaantum lahu munkiroona
verses.saheeh: And this [Qur'an] is a blessed message which We have sent down. Then are you with it unacquainted?
verses.khattab: And this ˹Quran˺ is a blessed reminder which We have revealed. Will you ˹pagans˺ then deny it
verses.jalalayn: And this, namely, the Qur'an, is a blessed Remembrance which We have revealed. Will you then deny it? (the interrogative here is intended as a rebuke).
verses.romanUrdu: Aur ab yeh ba-barakat “zikr” humne (tumhare liye) nazil kiya hai phir kya tum isko qabool karne se inkaari ho

verses.uthmani: ۞ وَلَقَدۡ ءَاتَيۡنَآ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ رُشۡدَهُۥ مِن قَبۡلُ وَكُنَّا بِهِۦ عَٰلِمِينَ
verses.indopak: ۞ وَلَـقَدْ اٰتَيْنَاۤ اِبْرٰهِيْمَ رُشْدَهٗ مِنْ قَبْلُ وَ كُنَّا بِهٖ عٰلِمِيْنَ ۚ
verses.transliteration: walaqad atayna ibraheema rushdahu min qablu wakunna bihi 'alimeena
verses.saheeh: And We had certainly given Abraham his sound judgement before, and We were of him well-Knowing
verses.khattab: And indeed, We had granted Abraham sound judgment early on, for We knew him well ˹to be worthy of it˺
verses.jalalayn: And verily We had given Abraham his rectitude before, that is, his [right] guidance before he came of age — and We were Aware of him, in that he was deserving of such [guidance],
verses.romanUrdu: Ussey bhi pehle humne Ibrahim ko uski hosh-mandi bakshi thi aur hum usko khoob jantey thay

verses.uthmani: إِذۡ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوۡمِهِۦ مَا هَٰذِهِ ٱلتَّمَاثِيلُ ٱلَّتِيٓ أَنتُمۡ لَهَا عَٰكِفُونَ
verses.indopak: اِذْ قَالَ لِاَبِيْهِ وَقَوْمِهٖ مَا هٰذِهِ التَّمَاثِيْلُ الَّتِىْۤ اَنْتُمْ لَهَا عٰكِفُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: ith qala liabeehi waqawmihi ma hathihi alttamatheelu allatee antum laha 'akifoona
verses.saheeh: When he said to his father and his people, "What are these statues to which you are devoted?"
verses.khattab: ˹Remember˺ when he questioned his father and his people, “What are these statues to which you are so devoted?”
verses.jalalayn: when he said to his father and his people, ‘What are these images, [these] idols, to which you [constantly] cleave?’, that is, which you are constantly worshipping.
verses.romanUrdu: Yaad karo woh mauqa ke usne apne baap aur apni qaum se kaha tha ke “yeh muratein (images) kaisi hain jinke tumlog girwida (devoted) ho rahey ho?”

verses.uthmani: قَالُواْ وَجَدۡنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا لَهَا عَٰبِدِينَ
verses.indopak: قَالُوْا وَجَدْنَاۤ اٰبَاۤءَنَا لَهَا عٰبِدِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: qaloo wajadna abaana laha 'abideena
verses.saheeh: They said, "We found our fathers worshippers of them."
verses.khattab: They replied, “We found our forefathers worshipping them.”
verses.jalalayn: They said, ‘We found our fathers worshipping them’, and so we followed their example.
verses.romanUrdu: Unhon ne jawab diya “humne apne baap dada ko inki ibadat karte paya hai”

verses.uthmani: قَالَ لَقَدۡ كُنتُمۡ أَنتُمۡ وَءَابَآؤُكُمۡ فِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٖ
verses.indopak: قَالَ لَـقَدْ كُنْتُمْ اَنْتُمْ وَاٰبَاۤؤُكُمْ فِىْ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِيْنٍ
verses.transliteration: qala laqad kuntum antum waabaokum fee dalalin mubeenin
verses.saheeh: He said, "You were certainly, you and your fathers, in manifest error."
verses.khattab: He responded, “Indeed, you and your forefathers have been clearly astray.”
verses.jalalayn: He said, to them, ‘Truly you and your fathers, by worshipping them, have been in manifest error’.
verses.romanUrdu: Usne kaha “tum bhi gumraah ho aur tumhare baap dada bhi sareeh gumaraahi mein paday huey thay?”

verses.uthmani: قَالُوٓاْ أَجِئۡتَنَا بِٱلۡحَقِّ أَمۡ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱللَّٰعِبِينَ
verses.indopak: قَالُوْۤا اَجِئْتَـنَا بِالْحَـقِّ اَمْ اَنْتَ مِنَ اللّٰعِبِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: qaloo ajitana bialhaqqi am anta mina alla'ibeena
verses.saheeh: They said, "Have you come to us with truth, or are you of those who jest?"
verses.khattab: They asked, “Have you come to us with the truth, or is this a joke?”
verses.jalalayn: They said, ‘Do you bring us the truth, in that which you are saying, or are you being frivolous?’, in this regard.
verses.romanUrdu: Unhon ne kaha “kya tu hamare samne apne asli khayalaat pesh kar raha hai ya mazaaq karta hai?”

verses.uthmani: قَالَ بَل رَّبُّكُمۡ رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ ٱلَّذِي فَطَرَهُنَّ وَأَنَا۠ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّٰهِدِينَ
verses.indopak: قَالَ بَلْ رَّبُّكُمْ رَبُّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ الَّذِىْ فَطَرَهُنَّ ۖ وَاَنَا۠ عَلٰى ذٰلِكُمْ مِّنَ الشّٰهِدِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: qala bal rabbukum rabbu alssamawati waalardi allathee fatarahunna waana 'ala thalikum mina alshshahideena
verses.saheeh: He said, "[No], rather, your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth who created them, and I, to that, am of those who testify.
verses.khattab: He replied, “In fact, your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, Who created them ˹both˺. And to that I bear witness.”
verses.jalalayn: He said, ‘Nay, but your Lord, the [only] One worthy of being worshipped, is the Lord, the Owner, of the heavens and the earth, [the One] Who originated them, [Who] created them without any precedent, and to that, which I have said, I am a witness.
verses.romanUrdu: Usne jawab diya “nahin, balke fil waqey tumhara Rubb wahi hai jo zameen aur aasmano ka Rubb aur unka paida karne wala hai, ispar main tumhare samne gawahi deta hoon

verses.uthmani: وَتَٱللَّهِ لَأَكِيدَنَّ أَصۡنَٰمَكُم بَعۡدَ أَن تُوَلُّواْ مُدۡبِرِينَ
verses.indopak: وَ تَاللّٰهِ لَاَكِيْدَنَّ اَصْنَامَكُمْ بَعْدَ اَنْ تُوَلُّوْا مُدْبِرِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: wataallahi laakeedanna asnamakum ba'da an tuwalloo mudbireena
verses.saheeh: And [I swear] by Allah, I will surely plan against your idols after you have turned and gone away."
verses.khattab: ˹Then he said to himself,˺ “By Allah! I will surely plot against your idols after you have turned your backs and gone away.”
verses.jalalayn: And, by God, I shall devise [a stratagem] against your idols after you have gone away, with your backs turned’.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur khuda ki kasam main tumhari gair maujoodgi mein zaroor tumhare buthon (idols/murtiyon) ki khabar lunga”

verses.uthmani: فَجَعَلَهُمۡ جُذَٰذًا إِلَّا كَبِيرٗا لَّهُمۡ لَعَلَّهُمۡ إِلَيۡهِ يَرۡجِعُونَ
verses.indopak: فَجَعَلَهُمْ جُذٰذًا اِلَّا كَبِيْرًا لَّهُمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ اِلَيْهِ يَرْجِعُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: faja'alahum juthathan illa kabeeran lahum la'allahum ilayhi yarji'oona
verses.saheeh: So he made them into fragments, except a large one among them, that they might return to it [and question].
verses.khattab: So he smashed them into pieces, except the biggest of them, so they might turn to it ˹for answers˺
verses.jalalayn: And so, after they had set off to a gathering of theirs on one of their festival days, he reduced them to fragments (read judhādhan or jidhādhan, meaning ‘pieces’), [smashing them] with a hatchet, [all] except the principal one among them, around whose neck he hung the hatchet, that they might return to it, that is, to the principal one, and see what he had done to the others.
verses.romanUrdu: Chunanchey usne unko tukde tukde kardiya aur sirf unke baday ko chodh diya taa-ke shayad woh iski taraf rujoo karein

verses.uthmani: قَالُواْ مَن فَعَلَ هَٰذَا بِـَٔالِهَتِنَآ إِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
verses.indopak: قَالُوْا مَنْ فَعَلَ هٰذَا بِاٰلِهَتِنَاۤ اِنَّهٗ لَمِنَ الظّٰلِمِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: qaloo man fa'ala hatha bialihatina innahu lamina alththalimeena
verses.saheeh: They said, "Who has done this to our gods? Indeed, he is of the wrongdoers."
verses.khattab: They protested, “Who dared do this to our gods? It must be an evildoer!”
verses.jalalayn: They said, upon returning and seeing what had been done, ‘Who has done this to our gods? Truly he is an evildoer’, in this regard.
verses.romanUrdu: Unhon ne aakar buthon[idols] ka yeh haal dekha to) kehne lagey “hamare khudaon ka yeh haal kisne kardiya? Bada hi koi zalim tha woh”

verses.uthmani: قَالُواْ سَمِعۡنَا فَتٗى يَذۡكُرُهُمۡ يُقَالُ لَهُۥٓ إِبۡرَٰهِيمُ
verses.indopak: قَالُوْا سَمِعْنَا فَتًى يَّذْكُرُهُمْ يُقَالُ لَهٗۤ اِبْرٰهِيْمُ ۗ
verses.transliteration: qaloo sami'na fatan yathkuruhum yuqalu lahu ibraheemu
verses.saheeh: They said, "We heard a young man mention them who is called Abraham."
verses.khattab: Some said, “We heard a young man, called Abraham, speaking ˹ill˺ of them.”
verses.jalalayn: They said, one to the other: ‘We heard a young man making [ill] mention of them, deriding them — he is called Abraham’.
verses.romanUrdu: (baaz log) boley “ humne ek nawjawan ko inka zikr karte suna tha jiska naam Ibrahim hai”

verses.uthmani: قَالُواْ فَأۡتُواْ بِهِۦ عَلَىٰٓ أَعۡيُنِ ٱلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَشۡهَدُونَ
verses.indopak: قَالُوْا فَأْتُوْا بِهٖ عَلٰۤى اَعْيُنِ النَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَشْهَدُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: qaloo fatoo bihi 'ala a'yuni alnnasi la'allahum yashhadoona
verses.saheeh: They said, "Then bring him before the eyes of the people that they may testify."
verses.khattab: They demanded, “Bring him before the eyes of the people, so that they may witness ˹his trial˺.”
verses.jalalayn: They said, ‘Then bring him before the people’s eyes, that is, openly, that they may testify’, against him as being the perpetrator.
verses.romanUrdu: Unhon ne kaha “ to pakad lao usey sabke samne taa-ke log dekh lein (uski kaisi khabar li jati hai)”

verses.uthmani: قَالُوٓاْ ءَأَنتَ فَعَلۡتَ هَٰذَا بِـَٔالِهَتِنَا يَٰٓإِبۡرَٰهِيمُ
verses.indopak: قَالُوْۤا ءَاَنْتَ فَعَلْتَ هٰذَا بِاٰلِهَتِنَا يٰۤاِبْرٰهِيْمُ ۗ
verses.transliteration: qaloo aanta fa'alta hatha bialihatina ya ibraheemu
verses.saheeh: They said, "Have you done this to our gods, O Abraham?"
verses.khattab: They asked, “Was it you who did this to our gods, O Abraham?”
verses.jalalayn: They said, to him, after he had been brought [before them]: ‘So, is it you (read a-anta, [either] pronouncing fully the two hamzas; or substituting an alif for the second one, or not pronouncing it [the second one], and inserting an alif between the one not pronounced and the other one, or without [this insertion]) who has done this to our gods, O Abraham?’
verses.romanUrdu: (Ibrahim ke aane par) unhon ne pucha “kyun Ibrahim, tu nay hamare khudaon ke saath yeh harakat ki hai

verses.uthmani: قَالَ بَلۡ فَعَلَهُۥ كَبِيرُهُمۡ هَٰذَا فَسۡـَٔلُوهُمۡ إِن كَانُواْ يَنطِقُونَ
verses.indopak: قَالَ بَلْ فَعَلَهٗ ۖ كَبِيْرُهُمْ هٰذَا فَسْـــَٔلُوْهُمْ اِنْ كَانُوْا يَنْطِقُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: qala bal fa'alahu kabeeruhum hatha faisaloohum in kanoo yantiqoona
verses.saheeh: He said, "Rather, this - the largest of them - did it, so ask them, if they should [be able to] speak."
verses.khattab: He replied ˹sarcastically˺, “No, this one—the biggest of them—did it! So ask them, if they can talk!”
verses.jalalayn: He said, concealing his deed: ‘Rather it was this principal one among them did it. So question them, about the perpetrator of this, if they can speak!’ (here the response to the conditional statement precedes [the conditional clause]; in the preceding clause there is an intimation for them that an idol, acknowledged as being incapable of action, cannot be a god).
verses.romanUrdu: Usne jawab diya “balke yeh sab kuch inke is sardar ne kiya hai, inhi se pooch lo agar yeh bolte hon”

verses.uthmani: فَرَجَعُوٓاْ إِلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمۡ فَقَالُوٓاْ إِنَّكُمۡ أَنتُمُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ
verses.indopak: فَرَجَعُوْۤا اِلٰۤى اَنْـفُسِهِمْ فَقَالُوْۤا اِنَّكُمْ اَنْـتُمُ الظّٰلِمُوْنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: faraja'oo ila anfusihim faqaloo innakum antumu alththalimoona
verses.saheeh: So they returned to [blaming] themselves and said [to each other], "Indeed, you are the wrongdoers."
verses.khattab: So they came back to their senses, saying ˹to one another˺, “You yourselves are truly the wrongdoers!”
verses.jalalayn: So they turned [thinking] to themselves, in reflection, and they said, to themselves: ‘Truly it is you who are the evildoers’, for worshipping that which cannot speak.
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh sunkar woh log apne zameer ki taraf palte aur (apne dilon mein) kehne lagey “waqayi tum khud hi zalim ho”

verses.uthmani: ثُمَّ نُكِسُواْ عَلَىٰ رُءُوسِهِمۡ لَقَدۡ عَلِمۡتَ مَا هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ يَنطِقُونَ
verses.indopak: ثُمَّ نُكِسُوْا عَلٰى رُءُوْسِہِمْ ۚ لَـقَدْ عَلِمْتَ مَا هٰۤؤُلَاۤءِ يَنْطِقُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: thumma nukisoo 'ala ruoosihim laqad 'alimta ma haolai yantiqoona
verses.saheeh: Then they reversed themselves, [saying], "You have already known that these do not speak!"
verses.khattab: Then they ˹quickly˺ regressed to their ˹original˺ mind-set, ˹arguing,˺ “You already know that those ˹idols˺ cannot talk.”
verses.jalalayn: Then they were turned, by God, on their heads, that is to say, they were made to return to their disbelief and said, ‘By God, you are certainly aware that these [idols] cannot speak’, in other words, how can you thus command us to question them?
verses.romanUrdu: Magar phir unki math palat gayi(minds became perverse) aur boley “ tu jaanta hai ke yeh bolte nahin hain”

verses.uthmani: قَالَ أَفَتَعۡبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنفَعُكُمۡ شَيۡـٔٗا وَلَا يَضُرُّكُمۡ
verses.indopak: قَالَ اَفَتَعْبُدُوْنَ مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ مَا لَا يَنْفَعُكُمْ شَيْـًٔـا وَّلَا يَضُرُّكُمْ ۗ
verses.transliteration: q<u>a</u>la afata'budoona min dooni all<u>a</u>hi m<u>a</u> l<u>a</u> yanfa'ukum shayan wal<u>a</u> ya<u>d</u>urrukum
verses.saheeh: He said, "Then do you worship instead of Allah that which does not benefit you at all or harm you?
verses.khattab: He rebuked ˹them˺, “Do you then worship—instead of Allah—what can neither benefit nor harm you in any way
verses.jalalayn: He said, ‘Do you then worship, besides God, that is, in His place, that which cannot benefit you in any way, with regard to [granting you] provision and otherwise, nor harm you?, in any way if you were not to worship it?
verses.romanUrdu: Ibrahim ne kaha “phir kya tum Allah ko chodh kar un cheezon ko poojh rahey ho jo na tumhein nafaa pahunchane par qadir hain na nuqsan

verses.uthmani: أُفّٖ لَّكُمۡ وَلِمَا تَعۡبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ أَفَلَا تَعۡقِلُونَ
verses.indopak: اُفٍّ لَّـكُمْ وَلِمَا تَعْبُدُوْنَ مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ ۗ اَفَلَا تَعْقِلُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: offin lakum walima ta'budoona min dooni allahi afala ta'qiloona
verses.saheeh: Uff to you and to what you worship instead of Allah. Then will you not use reason?"
verses.khattab: Shame on you and whatever you worship instead of Allah! Do you not have any sense?”
verses.jalalayn: Fie (read uffin or uffan, with the sense of a verbal noun, meaning ‘a putrid thing or a vile thing [be]’) on you and what you worship besides God, that is, other than Him. Do you not comprehend?’, that these idols are not worthy of being worshipped and are not fit for such [a purpose] — only God, exalted be He, is worthy of it.
verses.romanUrdu: Tuff (Fie) hai tumpar aur tumhare in maboodon par jinki tum Allah ko chodh kar pooja kar rahey ho, kya tum kuch bhi aqal nahin rakhte?”

verses.uthmani: قَالُواْ حَرِّقُوهُ وَٱنصُرُوٓاْ ءَالِهَتَكُمۡ إِن كُنتُمۡ فَٰعِلِينَ
verses.indopak: قَالُوْا حَرِّقُوْهُ وَانْصُرُوْۤا اٰلِهَتَكُمْ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ فٰعِلِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: qaloo harriqoohu waonsuroo alihatakum in kuntum fa'ileena
verses.saheeh: They said, "Burn him and support your gods - if you are to act."
verses.khattab: They concluded, “Burn him up to avenge your gods, if you must act.”
verses.jalalayn: They said, ‘Burn him, that is, [burn] Abraham, and stand by your gods, by having him burnt, if you are to do anything’, in the way of standing by them. Thus they gathered lots of firewood and lit a fire throughout it. They then tied up Abraham, placed him in a ballista and had him hurled into the fire. God, exalted be He, says:
verses.romanUrdu: Unhon ne kaha “jala daalo isko aur himayat karo apne khudaon ki agar tumhein kuch karna hai”

verses.uthmani: قُلۡنَا يَٰنَارُ كُونِي بَرۡدٗا وَسَلَٰمًا عَلَىٰٓ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ
verses.indopak: قُلْنَا يٰنَارُ كُوْنِىْ بَرْدًا وَّسَلٰمًا عَلٰۤى اِبْرٰهِيْمَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: qulna ya naru koonee bardan wasalaman 'ala ibraheema
verses.saheeh: Allah said, "O fire, be coolness and safety upon Abraham."
verses.khattab: We ordered, “O fire! Be cool and safe for Abraham!”
verses.jalalayn: We said, ‘O fire! Be coolness and safety for Abraham!’, and so it only consumed the bonds [with which he had been tied]. Its heat departed, but its luminosity remained. And by His words wa-salāman, ‘and safety’, Abraham was safe from (salima) death because of its coolness.
verses.romanUrdu: Humne kaha “Aey aag, thandi ho jaa aur salamati ban jaa Ibrahim par”

verses.uthmani: وَأَرَادُواْ بِهِۦ كَيۡدٗا فَجَعَلۡنَٰهُمُ ٱلۡأَخۡسَرِينَ
verses.indopak: وَاَرَادُوْا بِهٖ كَيْدًا فَجَعَلْنٰهُمُ الْاَخْسَرِيْنَ ۚ
verses.transliteration: waaradoo bihi kaydan faja'alnahumu alakhsareena
verses.saheeh: And they intended for him harm, but We made them the greatest losers.
verses.khattab: They had sought to harm him, but We made them the worst losers
verses.jalalayn: And they sought to outwit him, namely, by having him burnt, but We made them the greater losers, in what they sought.
verses.romanUrdu: Woh chahte thay ke Ibrahim ke saath burayi karein magar humne unko buri tarah nakaam kardiya

verses.uthmani: وَنَجَّيۡنَٰهُ وَلُوطًا إِلَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ ٱلَّتِي بَٰرَكۡنَا فِيهَا لِلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.indopak: وَنَجَّيْنٰهُ وَلُوْطًا اِلَى الْاَرْضِ الَّتِىْ بٰرَكْنَا فِيْهَا لِلْعٰلَمِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: wanajjaynahu walootan ila alardi allatee barakna feeha lil'alameena
verses.saheeh: And We delivered him and Lot to the land which We had blessed for the worlds.
verses.khattab: Then We delivered him, along with Lot, to the land We had showered with blessings for all people
verses.jalalayn: And We delivered him, as well as Lot — son of his [Abraham’s] brother Hārān — from Iraq, [and brought them] to the land which We have blessed for all peoples, [blessed it] with an abundance of rivers and trees, and this is Syria. Abraham settled in Palestine, and Lot in the Sinful City (al-mu’tafika, cf. Q. 53:53); and between the two is [the distance of] a day’s journey.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur hum usey aur Lut ko bacha kar us sar-zameen ki taraf nikal le gaye jismein humne duniya walon ke liye barkatein rakkhi hain

verses.uthmani: وَوَهَبۡنَا لَهُۥٓ إِسۡحَٰقَ وَيَعۡقُوبَ نَافِلَةٗ ۖ وَكُلّٗا جَعَلۡنَا صَٰلِحِينَ
verses.indopak: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهٗۤ اِسْحٰقَ ۗ وَيَعْقُوْبَ نَافِلَةً ۗ وَكُلًّا جَعَلْنَا صٰلِحِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: wawahabna lahu ishaqa waya'qooba nafilatan wakullan ja'alna saliheena
verses.saheeh: And We gave him Isaac and Jacob in addition, and all [of them] We made righteous.
verses.khattab: And We blessed him with Isaac ˹as a son˺ and Jacob ˹as a grandson˺, as an additional favour—making all of them righteous
verses.jalalayn: And We gave him, namely, Abraham — for he had asked for a child, as mentioned in [sūrat] al-Sāffāt [Q. 37:100] — Isaac, and Jacob as a gift, that is, as [something] in addition to what was requested; or it means ‘a grandson’; and each of them, that is, himself and the two born of him, We made righteous, [We made them] prophets.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur humne usey Ishaq ata kiya aur Yakoob uspar mazeed, aur har ek ko saleh (righteous) banaya

verses.uthmani: وَجَعَلۡنَٰهُمۡ أَئِمَّةٗ يَهۡدُونَ بِأَمۡرِنَا وَأَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَيۡهِمۡ فِعۡلَ ٱلۡخَيۡرَٰتِ وَإِقَامَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَإِيتَآءَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةِ ۖ وَكَانُواْ لَنَا عَٰبِدِينَ
verses.indopak: وَجَعَلْنٰهُمْ اَٮِٕمَّةً يَّهْدُوْنَ بِاَمْرِنَا وَاَوْحَيْنَاۤ اِلَيْهِمْ فِعْلَ الْخَيْرٰتِ وَاِقَامَ الصَّلٰوةِ وَاِيْتَاۤءَ الزَّكٰوةِ ۚ وَكَانُوْا لَـنَا عٰبِدِيْنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: waja'alnahum aimmatan yahdoona biamrina waawhayna ilayhim fi'la alkhayrati waiqama alssalati waeetaa alzzakati wakanoo lana 'abideena
verses.saheeh: And We made them leaders guiding by Our command. And We inspired to them the doing of good deeds, establishment of prayer, and giving of zakah; and they were worshippers of Us.
verses.khattab: We ˹also˺ made them leaders, guiding by Our command, and inspired them to do good deeds, establish prayer, and pay alms-tax. And they were devoted to Our worship
verses.jalalayn: And We made them leaders (read a-immatan pronouncing both hamzas, or substituting the second one with a yā’), whose example of good [conduct] is followed, guiding, people, by Our command, to Our religion, and We inspired in them the performance of good deeds and the maintenance of prayers and the payment of alms, that is, [We inspired] that these [good deeds] be performed, [prayers] be maintained, and [alms] be payed by them and by their followers (the [final] hā’ of iqāma has been omitted to soften [the reading]), and they used to worship Us.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur humne unko imam bana diya jo hamare hukum se rehnumayi karte thay aur humne unhein wahee (revelation) ke zariye neik kaamon ki aur namaz qayam karne ki aur zakat dene ki hidayat ki, aur woh hamare ibadat guzaar thay

verses.uthmani: وَلُوطًا ءَاتَيۡنَٰهُ حُكۡمٗا وَعِلۡمٗا وَنَجَّيۡنَٰهُ مِنَ ٱلۡقَرۡيَةِ ٱلَّتِي كَانَت تَّعۡمَلُ ٱلۡخَبَٰٓئِثَ ۚ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ قَوۡمَ سَوۡءٖ فَٰسِقِينَ
verses.indopak: وَلُوْطًا اٰتَيْنٰهُ حُكْمًا وَّعِلْمًا وَّنَجَّيْنٰهُ مِنَ الْقَرْيَةِ الَّتِىْ كَانَتْ تَّعْمَلُ الْخَبٰۤٮِٕثَ ۗ اِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْا قَوْمَ سَوْءٍ فٰسِقِيْنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: walootan ataynahu hukman wa'ilman wanajjaynahu mina alqaryati allatee kanat ta'malu alkhabaitha innahum kanoo qawma sawin fasiqeena
verses.saheeh: And to Lot We gave judgement and knowledge, and We saved him from the city that was committing wicked deeds. Indeed, they were a people of evil, defiantly disobedient.
verses.khattab: And to Lot We gave wisdom and knowledge, and delivered him from the society engrossed in shameful practices. They were certainly an evil, rebellious people
verses.jalalayn: And to Lot We gave judgement, the ability to judge decisively between opposing parties, and knowledge; and We delivered him from the town which had been committing, that is, whose inhabitants had been committing, deeds of, vileness, by way of homosexual intercourse, hazelnut-hurling and bird-games and other things. Truly they were a folk of evil [people] (saw’ is the verbal noun of sā’ahu, ‘he harmed him’, the opposite of sarrahu, ‘he delighted him’), immoral.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur Lut ko humne hukum aur ilm baksha aur usey us basti se bacha kar nikal diya jo badkariyan karti thi. Dar haqeeqat woh badi hi buri, fasiq qaum thi

verses.uthmani: وَأَدۡخَلۡنَٰهُ فِي رَحۡمَتِنَآ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
verses.indopak: وَاَدْخَلْنٰهُ فِىْ رَحْمَتِنَا ۗ اِنَّهٗ مِنَ الصّٰلِحِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: waadkhalnahu fee rahmatina innahu mina alssaliheena
verses.saheeh: And We admitted him into Our mercy. Indeed, he was of the righteous.
verses.khattab: And We admitted him into Our mercy, ˹for˺ he was truly one of the righteous
verses.jalalayn: And We admitted him into Our mercy, by Our saving him from his people. He was indeed one of the righteous.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur Lut ko humne apni rehmat mein dakhil kiya, woh saleh logon mein se tha

verses.uthmani: وَنُوحًا إِذۡ نَادَىٰ مِن قَبۡلُ فَٱسۡتَجَبۡنَا لَهُۥ فَنَجَّيۡنَٰهُ وَأَهۡلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلۡكَرۡبِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ
verses.indopak: وَنُوْحًا اِذْ نَادٰى مِنْ قَبْلُ فَاسْتَجَبْنَا لَهٗ فَنَجَّيْنٰهُ وَاَهْلَهٗ مِنَ الْكَرْبِ الْعَظِيْمِ ۚ
verses.transliteration: wanoohan ith nada min qablu faistajabna lahu fanajjaynahu waahlahu mina alkarbi al'atheemi
verses.saheeh: And [mention] Noah, when he called [to Allah] before [that time], so We responded to him and saved him and his family from the great flood.
verses.khattab: And ˹remember˺ when Noah had cried out to Us earlier, so We responded to him and delivered him and his family from the great distress
verses.jalalayn: And, mention, Noah (what follows [Nūhan] substitutes for it) when he called, when he supplicated [to God] against his people — with the words My Lord, do not leave [upon the earth any inhabitant from among the disbelievers] … to the end [of the verse, Q. 71:26], before, that is, before [the time of] Abraham and Lot. And We responded to him, and delivered him and his people, who were in the Ark with him, from the great agony, namely, [from] drowning and his people’s denial of him.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur yahi niyamat humne Nooh ko di, yaad karo jabke in sab se pehle usne humein pukara tha, humne uski dua qabool ki aur usey aur uske ghar walon ko karb-e-azeem (great calamity) se najaat di

verses.uthmani: وَنَصَرۡنَٰهُ مِنَ ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ ۚ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ قَوۡمَ سَوۡءٖ فَأَغۡرَقۡنَٰهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
